title: Internal: Recurring Payment Disputes vs. Stop Future Payments
summary: This document explains how to handle recurring debit card payment issues via two processes: debit disputes for past recurring charges (set dispute_category to 'recurring_charge_after_cancellation') and the recurring block feature to stop future recurring/subscription charges on the card (set_debit_card_recurring_block_7382). It also states the block takes effect within 24 hours, one-time purchases are unaffected, and subscriptions are not cancelled—customers must contact merchants separately.
faqs: Should I file a dispute for a recurring debit charge that already posted (past charges)?
What dispute_category should be used for recurring charges after cancellation?
How do I stop future recurring/subscription charges on the customer’s debit card?
Does the recurring block stop only one merchant’s recurring payments or all merchants?
When is the recurring block effective, and are one-time purchases affected?
If the customer needs both—dispute past charges and prevent future ones—what order should I follow?
keywords: does NOT cancel subscriptions (must contact merchants)
